title: WatchlistAllocationContract
description: Canonical JSON Schema for watchlist allocation and rebalance endpoints under /api/v1/watchlist. Public API expresses target_percent and invested_amount as decimal values with up to two fractional digits; null clears the persisted value.

AllocationStatus.description: Overall allocation status. balanced means total persisted target basis points equal 10000; under/over are warnings, not blockers.

DriftBand.description: Server-computed drift severity band for UI coloring.

TargetPercent.description: Public decimal percentage with up to two fractional digits. Backend persists the value as integer basis points.

InvestedAmount.description: Manual invested position in base currency with up to two fractional digits. Backend persists as integer cents.

target_percent.description: Optional saved allocation target. null or absence means no target is set for this watchlist item.

invested_amount.description: Optional saved invested amount. null or absence means no invested value is set.

current_weight_percent.description: Current portfolio weight derived from invested amounts. null when total_invested is zero.

drift_percent.description: Current weight minus target percent. null when target or total_invested is unavailable.

suggestion_amount.description: Buy/sell suggestion in base currency. Positive buy, negative sell. null when suggestions are not ready.

drift_band.description: Server-computed drift severity for UI badges.

target_percent_total.description: Sum of saved item targets expressed as public decimal percent.

WatchlistAllocationSummary.description: Overall watchlist allocation summary. Status is computed canonically by the backend from integer basis points.

total_invested.description: Sum of invested amounts across watchlist items.

suggestions_ready.description: True when total_invested > 0 and allocation targets sum to 100%.

max_drift_percent.description: Maximum absolute drift across items with non-null drift. null when no drift is available.

RebalanceSummary.description: Portfolio-level rebalance summary computed canonically by the backend.

WatchlistResponse.description: GET /api/v1/watchlist success body with current watchlist fields plus allocation and rebalance metadata.

target_percent.description: Set a target when numeric; null clears the target while keeping the asset in the watchlist.

invested_amount.description: Set invested amount when numeric; null clears invested value while keeping the asset in the watchlist.
